mission.label: Our mission
mission.title: Democratise the science of revenue.
mission.description: The Revenue discipline of the best scale-ups, <0>finally within reach of B2B companies</0>.
mission.body: The fastest scale-ups have learnt to build their growth on a commercial machine: a readable pipeline, clean handovers, tools the teams actually use.

Most B2B companies do not have one yet. Their growth rests on individual effort: a few salespeople who outperform the rest, methods that live in people's heads, and results that waver as soon as one of them leaves.
mission.conclusion: Our job: build it with you, with your teams, in your tools.
ai.label: AI, on solid foundations
ai.title: Your AI agents will never be better than the data and processes you give them.
ai.lead: Many AI projects stay at the proof-of-concept stage. Not because the models are poor, but because they work on incomplete data, definitions that change from one team to the next and processes nobody has written down.
ai.promise: We structure the context first, then bring AI where it really serves your teams.

comparatif.gap.consulting.title: Consultancy
comparatif.gap.consulting.text: Strategy, organisation, recommendations. Stops before the tools.
comparatif.gap.integrator.title: Integrator
comparatif.gap.integrator.text: Configuration, integrations, automations. Starts without the strategy.
comparatif.gap.label: The gap
comparatif.gap.conclusion: In between, strategy never reaches the tools, and the tools never serve the strategy.
comparatif.gap.promise: Ocobo closes this gap: we decide with you, then we build.
stack.title.line1: The right technology. At the right time.
stack.description: We never start from a tool, but from your context: your organisation, your processes, what you already use. We recommend only what serves your teams, and we build a system that fits what is already there.
stack.tagline: Our role: dismantle bloated stacks and make yours useful.
cta.title: What is still holding your growth back?
cta.subtitle: In 30 minutes, a revenue architect talks with you about your challenges and the maturity of your commercial machine. You leave with your priorities and know where to start.
